hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.name: bucket_s3_names
hudson.model.TextParameterDefinition.description: all buckets in this account for this acronym, enter delimited i.e. nih-nhlbi-topmed-freeze9-batch3-phs001040-c1 nih-nhlbi-topmed-freeze9-batch3-phs001040-c2

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
# --- Configuration & Optimizations --- mkdir -p downloads FLAT_DIR="downloads_flat" rm -rf "$FLAT_DIR" mkdir -p "$FLAT_DIR"
export AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS="${AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS:-10}" export AWS_RETRY_MODE="${AWS_RETRY_MODE:-adaptive}" export AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS="${AWS_S3_MAX_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS:-64}" export AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE="${AWS_S3_MAX_QUEUE_SIZE:-10000}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_THRESHOLD:-64MB}" export AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE="${AWS_S3_MULTIPART_CHUNKSIZE:-64MB}" export AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_CONNECT_TIMEOUT:-10}" export AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT="${AWS_CLI_READ_TIMEOUT:-0}"
# --- Step 1: Download & Flatten (with on-the-fly decompression) --- for bucket_s3_name in ${bucket_s3_names}; do echo "Processing bucket: ${bucket_s3_name}"
# Securely assume role and parse with jq CREDS=$(aws sts assume-role \ --role-arn "arn:aws:iam::${nhlbi_account_number}:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3" \ --role-session-name "get-phenotypic-data" \ --output json)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
# Download files aws s3 cp --recursive "s3://${bucket_s3_name}/" downloads/ \ --exclude "*" --include "*.txt*" --exclude "*.gtc.*" --exclude "*phg00*" --exclude "*genotype-BAF*" \ --exclude "SOL_Metabochip*" --include "*.xml*" --no-progress
echo "Flattening and decompressing files from ${bucket_s3_name}..."
# Find files and process them # This replaces the nested while loop with a more robust version find downloads/ -type f \( -iname "*.txt*" -o -iname "*.xml*" \) -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do rel="${f#downloads/}" #safe_rel="${rel//\//__}" # Replace slashes with double underscores safe_rel="${rel##*/}" #flatten the rel if [[ "$safe_rel" == *.gz ]]; then # Remove .gz extension for the flat destination out="${FLAT_DIR}/${safe_rel%.gz}" # Decompress directly to the flat directory gzip -dc "$f" > "$out" else out="${FLAT_DIR}/${safe_rel}" # Link for efficiency, fallback to copy if linking fails ln -f "$f" "$out" 2>/dev/null || cp -f "$f" "$out" fi done
# Clear credentials before next loop iteration unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN done
# --- Step 2: Upload Flattened Data --- echo "Assuming ETL role for upload..." UPLOAD_CREDS=$(aws sts assume-role --duration-seconds 3600 \ --role-arn arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl \ --role-session-name "s3-upload-step" \ --output json)
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$(echo "$UPLOAD_CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId') export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$(echo "$UPLOAD_CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey') export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN=$(echo "$UPLOAD_CREDS" | jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken')
echo "Uploading flattened files to S3..." aws s3 cp "$FLAT_DIR/" "s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abv_name,,}/rawData/" \ --recursive --no-progress
echo "Pipeline complete."
